name: Hair By Milly
description: Hair By Milly is a cut-and-color stylist known for precision haircuts, soft face-framing layers, lived-in brunettes and blondes, and bouncy blowouts — modern hair that grows out beautifully.

hero.title: Cuts that make you feel brand new.
hero.subtitle: Precision cuts, soft layers, lived-in color, and bouncy blowouts by Milly — book your appointment today.

stylists.name: Milly
stylists.title: Owner & Stylist
stylists.bio: Milly is a cut-obsessed stylist who loves creating precision cuts, soft layers, and lived-in color that grows out beautifully. Every appointment starts with a real conversation about your hair, your routine, and the look you love.

reviews.name: Emily K.
reviews.text: Best haircut I've ever had. Milly's layers are perfect and my hair finally has shape and movement.

reviews.name: Hannah S.
reviews.text: My balayage grows out so softly — no harsh lines at all. She really knows what she's doing.

reviews.name: Olivia R.
reviews.text: Milly listened to exactly what I wanted and gave me the cutest bob. So sweet and so talented!

reviews.name: Grace W.
reviews.text: Her blowouts are amazing. I leave feeling like a brand new person every single time.
